scope: MCP API, Postgres control plane, A2A message bus, proposal workflow

targets.measurement_method: percentile_cont(0.99) from roadmap.trace_span WHERE operation='mcp_tool_call' AND started_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'
error count / total count from roadmap.trace_span WHERE operation='mcp_tool_call' AND started_at > now() - interval '30 seconds'

availability.downtime_definition: minutes in Down state, excluding planned maintenance

Degraded.description: One or more SLO threshold breached for >= 30 consecutive seconds
criteria: MCP API and Postgres still reachable
MCP process not responding for >= 30 seconds OR postgres connection refused for >= 30 seconds

observability.health_check_output_format: { state: Normal|Degraded|Down, sla_version: string, metrics: {...}, breached_slos: string[], since: ISO8601 }

prometheus_metrics.name: agenthive_mcp_call_duration_seconds
prometheus_metrics.description: MCP tool call latency histogram with buckets (0.1, 0.5, 1.0 seconds)

prometheus_metrics.name: agenthive_mcp_error_rate
prometheus_metrics.description: Current MCP error rate percentage over 30s window

prometheus_metrics.name: agenthive_stale_agent_pct
prometheus_metrics.description: Current stale/offline/crashed agent percentage from roadmap_workforce.agent_health

failure_modes.name: postgres_restart
failure_modes.recovery_mechanism: systemd watchdog, WAL ensures zero data loss

failure_modes.name: network_partition
failure_modes.recovery_mechanism: circuit breaker, fail-fast on MCP client

failure_modes.name: liaison_session_orphan
failure_modes.recovery_mechanism: self-healing session cleanup on next boot

tier_0_self_healing.action: Auto-log to roadmap.sla_events, fire NOTIFY to alert_channel

tier_1_operator_alert.trigger: Degraded state sustained > 5 minutes OR Down state entered

tier_2_incident.trigger: Down > 10 minutes OR error budget > 50% consumed
tier_2_incident.action: Formal incident log in roadmap.proposals; all active agents notified

tier_3_emergency.trigger: Down > 30 minutes OR error budget 100% consumed
tier_3_emergency.action: Halt new lease grants; escalate to platform lead

federation_sla_compatibility.description: When establishing a federation peer connection (P063), the local node validates peer SLA contract
federation_sla_compatibility.logging: Logged to roadmap.sla_events on validation failure

review_cadence.trigger_first_production_deployment: 30-day post-deploy review; replace Appendix A baseline with real traffic; version bump 1.0 → 1.1
review_cadence.trigger_quarterly: Every 90 days; compare actual vs. target from sla_events; update targets if sustained > 20% divergence
review_cadence.trigger_error_budget_80_percent: Ad-hoc review; root cause analysis; target reassessment
review_cadence.trigger_major_architectural_change: Impact assessment; evaluate whether SLA targets remain valid
review_cadence.version_scheme: semver; minor bump for target adjustments, major for structural changes

source_of_truth_hierarchy.description: Machine-readable, versioned, authoritative at runtime. /api/sla serves this file directly.
source_of_truth_hierarchy.usage: Runtime health_check output, federation peer validation, observability

source_of_truth_hierarchy.description: Human-readable narrative; must never contradict sla-contract.json. On divergence, JSON wins.
source_of_truth_hierarchy.usage: Operator reference, SLA review documentation, architectural guidance

source_of_truth_hierarchy.description: Runtime overrides only; shadows JSON defaults for the running instance.
source_of_truth_hierarchy.usage: Per-deployment configuration adjustments without code redeploy

rollback_procedure.description: All new artifacts are additive; rollback has no FK cascade impact
steps: Remove health_check action from opsRoutes in src/apps/mcp-server/tools/consolidated.ts
Remove /metrics and /api/sla HTTP routes from src/apps/server/index.ts
Remove latency timing from callTool() in src/apps/mcp-server/server.ts
Remove agenthive ops health CLI subcommand

tables_created.name: roadmap.sla_config
tables_created.purpose: Runtime configuration overrides for SLA thresholds
tables_created.schema: key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ

tables_created.name: roadmap.sla_events
tables_created.purpose: Event log for SLA state transitions and threshold breaches
tables_created.schema: event_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, event_type TEXT, state TEXT, metrics JSONB, occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ, acknowledged_at TIMESTAMPTZ, escalation_tier INT

acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC-1: SLA targets defined: p99 < 500ms, 99.5% monthly availability, RTO < 5min, lease TTL 30min, degraded at >10% errors, 100 concurrent agents baseline
acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC-2: Platform states (Normal, Degraded, Down) documented with observable thresholds
acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC-3: health_check MCP tool returns current SLA state with metric values
acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC-4: Prometheus /metrics endpoint exposes latency histogram, error rate, availability gauge
acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC-5: Degraded state triggers notification to agents; thresholds configurable per deployment
acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC-6: Availability formula with planned maintenance and partial outage treatment explicitly defined
acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC-7: Baseline measurement data collected; p99 latency and error rates in Appendix A
acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC-8: Configuration mechanism specified (env vars + roadmap.sla_config DB table with tier precedence)
acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC-9: All failure modes enumerated with RTO/RPO targets
acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC-10: Dashboard and CLI visibility for SLA state
